root_cause.text: The error path in `io_import_umem()` after `sg_alloc_table_from_pages()` fails leaks the `pages` array because it only unpins the individual pages without freeing the array itself.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `kvfree(pages)` in the failure branch (line 200 in the diff) which previously only had `unpin_user_pages(pages, nr_pages)`; the commit message explicitly states "didn't free the page array, release it as well."
